name: Point-Tessellated Voxelization
aliases: Hardware-based triangle subdivision and point-based surface voxelization
definition: A GPU-based framework for real-time multi-valued surface voxelization that uses hardware tessellation to subdivide triangles, generates point primitives at the centroids of subdivided triangles, and rasterizes these points into a volume texture to achieve gap-free (watertight) voxelization.
summary: Point-Tessellated Voxelization is a GPU framework that subdivides triangles into points to rasterize gap-free voxel grids, balancing performance and accuracy without expensive overlap tests.
